description: Decode ABI-encoded hex data back into human-readable values (cast abi-decode)

input.description: If true, decode as input data (function args). If false/omitted, decode as output data (return values).

signature.description: Solidity function signature whose output types to decode against, e.g. "balanceOf(address)(uint256)" or "transfer(address,uint256)"

name: cast_abi_decode
